# How do I get access to OAuth institutions?

The path to OAuth institution access depends on which plan you're on.

### If you're on a Trial plan

[Trial plan](https://plaid.com/docs/account/billing/#trial-plans) customers have access to all [OAuth institutions](https://plaid.com/docs/link/oauth/) without completing the full [Production](https://plaid.com/docs/quickstart/glossary/#production) registration requirements. Plaid collects the necessary information during Trial plan signup, so you do not need to separately provide application display information, company information, the MSA addendum, or the [Plaid security questionnaire](https://dashboard.plaid.com/overview/questionnaire-start). You can start connecting to OAuth institutions right away.

If you are unable to connect to a specific institution, ask [Bill](https://dashboard.plaid.com/support/new), Plaid's AI assistant. Support cases are available only on paid plans.

If you step up to a paid plan, you will need to complete the full OAuth registration requirements described below. Most of this information is collected during [Trial plan](https://plaid.com/docs/account/billing/#trial-plans) sign up, though a few fields are optional at that stage. You can fill in any missing details from the [Compliance Center](https://dashboard.plaid.com/settings/company/compliance) of the [Dashboard](https://dashboard.plaid.com/).

### If you're requesting full Production access (US-based integrations)

For US-based integrations, you will need to complete the following steps:

1. [**Request Production access from Plaid**](https://dashboard.plaid.com/overview/production)**.** [Production](https://plaid.com/docs/quickstart/glossary/#production) access — via either a paid plan or a Trial plan — is a prerequisite for supporting OAuth in the US. Plaid will contact you once your account has been enabled for full Production.
2. **Complete the** [**registration requirements**](https://plaid.com/docs/link/oauth/)**.** Before implementing support for OAuth institutions, be sure to complete the registration requirements in the [Plaid Dashboard](https://dashboard.plaid.com/). This includes providing application display information, company information, agreeing to the Plaid Master Services Agreement, and completing the [Plaid security questionnaire](https://dashboard.plaid.com/overview/questionnaire-start).

You can view the [OAuth institutions](https://dashboard.plaid.com/activity/status/oauth-institutions) page on the Dashboard to see the current status of your registration.

### For Europe-based integrations

For Europe-based integrations, you will need at least [Limited Production](https://plaid.com/docs/quickstart/glossary/#limited-production) access to use OAuth institutions. (The Trial plan is currently available only to developers in the US and Canada.)
